# proxmox_cluster_ceph_metadata (Data Source)

Reads Ceph daemon metadata from `/cluster/ceph/metadata` as JSON.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_cluster_ceph_metadata" "versions" {
  scope = "versions"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `scope` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `metadata` (String)
